title: Partner marketplace value matrix and legal gates (draft)
body:
Purpose:
This is a working draft to align product, legal, and partner success on what constitutes an acceptable marketplace listing for third-party partners and integrated ISVs. Focus is on: clear value mapping for merchant personas, minimum legal/compliance gates, billing/sku edge-cases, and copy variants that fit AWS/Azure/GCP tile constraints.

High-level goals:
- Make it unambiguous which partners can publish without enterprise legal review.
- Provide a short, scannable value matrix for marketplace reviewers and partner reps.
- Surface the most likely billing and attribution edge-cases early so engineering and finance can triage.
- Give marketing copy options sized for tile titles, short descriptions, and long descriptions.

Audience:
- Partner GTM managers
- Marketplace publishing team
- Partner success / legal review queue
- Product managers for integrations

1) Partner-to-customer value matrix (scannable)
Columns: partner-type | target-customer | core benefit | expected integration complexity | recommended listing tier
- SaaS connector (no data leaves customer cloud) | SMB / mid-market | quick 1-click connector for embeddings/search | low | self-serve
- Managed model supplier (hosted model via Redwood API) | Enterprise | lower latency and predictable SLAs, managed updates | medium | sales-assisted (legal review recommended)
- On-prem appliance (private deployment) | Regulated enterprise | Data residency + audited install | high | enterprise-only (contract + compliance)
Notes: these categories should map to licensing terms and whether we allow public marketplace billing or require direct contracting.

2) Minimum legal & compliance gates (yes/no checklist)
- Does the listing require customer data to leave their VPC? (YES -> require Private deployment eligibility + security review)
- Is partner offering billing through the marketplace or via direct invoicing? (Marketplace billing -> confirm reseller contract template)
- Does the partner claim model performance/benchmarks? (YES -> require reproducible benchmark artifact or signed claim appendix)
- Does the solution handle regulated data classes (PHI, PCI)? (YES -> require SOC2 + data flow diagram + KMS/HSM integration statement)
- Is export control or data residency a factor for target geos? (YES -> include allowed geos and restrict listing visibility)
Open questions: how to treat partners that say "supports EU" but offer hosted instances in a single region. Propose: require explicit region selection and data residency SLAs.

3) Billing / SKU mapping guide (practical rules & edge cases)
- Preferred: single marketplace SKU for the listing with unit-based metering (e.g., monthly seats, inference-units).
- Complex: multi-SKU bundles (e.g., base platform SKU + addon model SKU). Rule: require a schematic that maps usage dimensions to line items; finance must approve any >2 SKU bundles.
- Edge case: partner wants to route marketplace payments to a reseller partner. Action: reseller workflow required; attach reselling agreement.
- Free tier / trial: must include explicit trial length, auto-conversion policy, and cancellation flow documented.

4) Copy guide (tile-length constraints + suggested variants)
Constraints: Most marketplaces enforce tight character limits. Provide three layers: tile title (20 chars), short blurb (80 chars), long blurb (300 chars).
- Variant A (product-first):
  Title: "Redwood Connector"
  Short: "Realtime vector search for your product docs"
  Long: "Add instant, relevance-first search to product docs using a hosted Redwood connector. Low-latency embeddings and hosted index maintenance—no infra overhead."
- Variant B (cost/perf-first):
  Title: "Low-cost LLM Inference"
  Short: "Serve LLMs with predictable latency and cost"
  Long: "Run models on optimized infrastructure with autoscale and cost controls. Perfect for customer-facing features that need tight SLAs and transparent unit economics."
- Variant C (enterprise/security-first):
  Title: "Private Deployments (VPC)"
  Short: "Isolated inference for regulated data"
  Long: "Deploy Redwood in your VPC with KMS integration, audit logs, and enterprise support—designed for PHI/PCI-sensitive workloads and strict compliance needs."
Notes: choose variant based on the value matrix row. Keep marketing-speak minimal for technical reviewers.

5) QA acceptance tests for listing publish (engineering & ops checklist)
- Asset checks: icons (PNG 600x600), screenshots, video link OK, no PII in screenshots.
- Integration sample: provide a minimal "hello world" API call or terraform snippet that demonstrates provisioning or API usage.
- Region gating: metadata must list available regions and whether the deployment is multi-zone.
- Billing proof: attach sample invoice or SKU mapping doc.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 report link or CT artifact, and a KMS/secret rotation statement if applicable.
- Rollout plan: staged visibility (internal-beta -> private listings -> public) with rollback triggers and owner contact info.

6) Rollback & incident runbook (short)
- Critical failure modes: billing misattribution, data exfil via partner-hosted model, region misadvertised.
- Immediate actions: remove listing from public catalog (GTM ops), revoke marketplace entitlements (billing team), notify partner success & legal.
- Communication template: short email and marketplace-notice copy for impacted customers.

7) Partner comms & launch checklist (PR-friendly bullets)
- Confirm partner legal signoff and resale policy.
- Approve tile copy and screenshots (marketing + product).
- Schedule go-live announcement window and required support coverage.
- Prepare measurement: link to UTM parameters, trial conversion dashboard, and refund policy.

Appendix: unresolved decisions / TODOs
- Decision: what threshold of revenue or usage triggers a Dedicated capacity offering? (action: product + finance to define by 2025-02-15)
- Decision: how strictly do we enforce region-only visibility when partner claims multi-region? (action: legal + infra to propose enforcement)
- TODO: finalize reseller agreement template and attach to this doc (owner: Priya).
- TODO: create lightweight benchmark artifact template partners can fill (owner: Diego).

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally terse. Aim: give a single-page acceptance flow for marketplace ops. If you want a fully enumerated checklist per marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP) I can expand into a table with exact character limits and asset specs.
- If product wants more copy variants, tell me target persona and I'll draft 3 A/B pairs per persona.

Comments inline welcome — add feedback or ping me on Slack @samira.
